title: देउवा कांग्रेसको लुम्बिनीमा नेतृत्वको तयारी तीव्र, शेरबहादुरसहितका ७ नेताहरु भोलि आउँदै
content:
रुपन्देही । नेपाली कांग्रेसको शेरबहादुर देउवा पक्षले लुम्बिनी प्रदेशमा संगठनात्मक गतिविधि तीव्र बनाउँदै प्रदेश नेतृत्व चयनको तयारी अघि बढाएको छ । प्रदेश अधिवेशनलाई आगामी केन्द्रीय महाधिवेशनको शक्ति परीक्षणका रूपमा हेरिएकाले प्रदेश सभापतिसहित पदाधिकारी चयनमा नेताहरूले आन्तरिक छलफल र समर्थन जुटाउने प्रयास थालेका छन् । देउवा पक्षले प्रदेश अधिवेशन दाङको भालुवाङमा गर्ने तयारी गरेको छ । अधिवेशनमा प्रदेशका १२ जिल्लाबाट प्रतिनिधि सहभागी हुने भएकाले जिल्ला तहको शक्ति सन्तुलन, प्रतिनिधिको व्यवस्थापन र नेतृत्वका आकांक्षीबीचको समीकरणले परिणाम प्रभावित पार्ने देखिएको छ । प्रदेश सभापतिका लागि अहिले प्रदेशको संयोजक रहेका दाङका गेहेन्द्र गिरी, प्रदेशका पूर्वमन्त्री प्यूठानका रोज राणा, प्रदेश योजना आयोगका पूर्व सदस्य रुपन्देहीका डा. दामोदर भुसाल, रोल्पाका दुर्गा खड्कासहितका नेताहरूको नाम चर्चामा छ । बर्दियाका संजय गौतमको नाम लिइएपनि उनी त्यति धेरै क्रियाशील नभएकाले छलफलमा लगिएको छैन । नेताहरूले आफ्नो पक्षमा समर्थन जुटाउन जिल्ला नेतृत्व, क्षेत्रीय प्रतिनिधि र प्रदेशस्तरका नेताहरूसँग छलफल गरिरहेका छन् । आकांक्षीहरु धेरै भएपनि अहिलेका प्रदेश संयोजकलाई केन्द्रमा लगेर प्रदेश सरकारमा रहँदा प्रभावकारी काम देखाएका र शेरबहादुर देउवा तथा आरजु देउवासँग निकटस्थ रहेका रोज राणालाई नै सर्वसम्मत बनाउने गरी नेतृत्वले तयारी गरेको छ तर अहिले नै त्यो विषय टुंगो नलागेको नेताहरुको भनाइ छ । ‘युवा पुस्ताको कुरा पनि छ, सक्रियताको पनि कुरा छ, गेहेन्द्रजीलाई केन्द्रमा लगेर यहाँ युवा साथीहरुलाई नै अघि सार्नेगरी सहमति जुट्छहोला,’ सो समूहका एक नेताले नेपाल प्रेससँग भने । राणाले सबैभन्दा बढी समूहलाई बलियो बनाएको भन्दै चर्चामा छन् । यी हुन् टुंगो लागेका १२ जिल्लाका सभापतिहरुः देउवा समूहबाट प्रदेशका १२ जिल्लामध्ये १० वटामा जिल्ला नेतृत्व टुंगो लागिसकेको छ भने रुपन्देही र पाल्पामा आजै टुंगो लगाएर भोलिदेखि प्रदेशको नेतृत्वका लागि अघिवेशनको तयारी गरिएको हो । रुपन्देही र पाल्पामा पनि नेतृत्वको विषय करिब टुंगो लागेको र अन्य पदहरुमा आइतबार बसेर टुंगो लगाइने नेताहरुको भनाइ छ । समूहको प्यूठानमा सभापति देवेन्द्र बर्मा, रोल्पामा मानबहादुर खत्री, अर्घाखाँचीमा बाबुराम पौडेल, दाङमा गोपालराज शर्मा, कपिलवस्तुमा राजेश सिंह, बर्दियामा जग्गाप्रसाद पाण्डे, बाँकेमा प्रमोद श्रेष्ठ, पश्चिमनवलपरासीमा गोपी पुन, गुल्मीमा देव मगर, रुकुमपूर्वमा दत्त बस्नेत सभापतित्वमा नयाँ नेतृत्व बनिसकेको छ भने रुपन्देहीमा गुनाखर भुर्तेल र पाल्पामा माधव नेपालको नेतृत्वमा करिब समझदारी भइसकेको छ । देउवासहित प्रभावशाली नेताहरुको लर्कोः प्रदेशको अधिवेशनमा समूहका प्रभावशाली नेताहरुको ठूलो समूह आउने भएको छ । नेता शेरबहादुर देउवाले उद्घाटन गर्ने यो अधिवेशनमा शशांक कोइराला, विमलेन्द्र निधि, प्रकाशमान सिंह, एनपी साउद, प्रकाशशरण महत, मोहन बस्नेतसहितका नेताहरु आउने निश्चित भएको नेता रोज राणाले जानकारी दिए । भालुवाङस्थित पौवा होटलमा गर्न लागिएको सो अधिवेशनमा सबै जिल्लाबाट आउने तयारी अन्तिम चरणमा रहेको उनले जनाए । ‘उद्घाटन शेरबहादुर दाईबाटै हुन्छ, अरु सिनियर नेताहरु धेरै आजसम्म आइपग्नुहुन्छहोला, नेतृत्वको कुरा समझदारीमै टुंगिन्छ, आकांक्षा राख्ने विषय स्वभाविक हो,’ उनले भने । पहिले यो समूहमा लुम्बिनीबाट रहेका धेरै नेताहरु संस्थापन समूहमा लागेपछि कमजोरजस्तै देखिएपनि अहिले सबै जिल्लामा संगठन बिस्तार गरेको हो । यही समूहमा रहेर अहिले संस्थापनबाट अर्घाखाँचीकी पुष्पा भुसाल उपसभापति बनेकी छन् भने पश्चिमनवलपरासीका विनोद चौधरी पनि उपसभापति बनेका छन् । दाङका योगेन्द्र चौधरी सहमहामन्त्री बनेका छन् भने बर्दियाका किशोरसिंह राठौर सभापतिमै उम्मेदारी दिएर पछि समझदारीमा बाहिर आएका हुन् । नवलपरासीमो देवेन्द्रराज कँडेल सहमहामन्त्रीमा पराजित भएका थिए भने रुपन्देहीका बालकृष्ण खाण, प्रदेशका पूर्वमुख्यमन्त्री डिल्ली चौधरी, पूर्वमन्त्री राजु खनालसहितका नेताहरुले पनि देउवाको साथ छाडेर संस्थापनमा लागेका थिए । Rupandehi. The Sher Bahadur Deuba faction of the Nepali Congress has intensified organizational activities in Lumbini Province and is preparing to select the provincial leadership. As the provincial convention is seen as a test of strength for the upcoming central convention, leaders have begun internal discussions and efforts to gather support for the selection of office bearers, including the provincial president. The Deuba faction is preparing to hold the provincial convention in Bhaluwang, Dang. As representatives from 12 districts of the province will participate in the convention, the balance of power at the district level, the management of representatives, and the equation between leadership aspirants are seen to affect the results. The names of leaders in the discussion for the provincial president include Gehendra Giri of Dang, who is currently the provincial coordinator, Roz Rana of Pyuthan, former provincial minister, Dr. Damodar Bhusal of Rupandehi, and Durga Khadka of Rolpa. Although the name of Sanjay Gautam of Bardiya was mentioned, he has not been included in the discussion as he is not very active. The leaders are holding discussions with the district leadership, regional representatives, and provincial-level leaders to garner support for their side. Although there are many aspirants, the leadership has made preparations to take the current provincial coordinator to the center and unanimously select Roz Rana, who has shown effective work during his time in the provincial government and is close to Sher Bahadur Deuba and Arju Deuba, but the leaders say that the issue has not been finalized yet. "There is also the issue of the younger generation, there is also the issue of activism. Perhaps a consensus will be reached to take Gehendraji to the center and promote the young friends here," a leader of the group told Nepal Press. Rana is in the news for having strengthened the group the most. These are the 12 district chairmen who have been finalized: The Deuba group has already finalized the district leadership in 10 of the 12 districts of the province, while Rupandehi and Palpa have been finalized today and preparations are underway to move forward with the provincial leadership from tomorrow. Leaders say that the leadership issue in Rupandehi and Palpa is almost finalized and other positions will be finalized on Sunday. The group has a new leadership under the chairmanship of Devendra Barma in Pyuthan, Man Bahadur Khatri in Rolpa, Baburam Poudel in Arghakhanchi, Gopal Raj Sharma in Dang, Rajesh Singh in Kapilvastu, Jagga Prasad Pandey in Bardiya, Pramod Shrestha in Banke, Gopi Pun in West Nawalparasi, Dev Magar in Gulmi, and Dutta Basnet in Rukumpur. An agreement has almost been reached on the leadership of Gunakhar Bhurtel in Rupandehi and Madhav Nepal in Palpa. The list of influential leaders, including Deuba: A large group of influential leaders of the group are expected to attend the provincial convention. Leader Roz Rana informed that leaders including Shashank Koirala, Bimalendra Nidhi, Prakash Man Singh, NP Saud, Prakash Sharan Mahat, Mohan Basnet are certain to attend the convention to be inaugurated by leader Sher Bahadur Deuba. He said that preparations for all districts to attend the convention to be held at Pauwa Hotel in Bhaluwang are in the final stages. 'The inauguration will be done by Sher Bahadur Dai, many other senior leaders will probably come by today, the matter of leadership will be resolved through understanding, it is natural to have aspirations,' he said. Although many leaders from Lumbini in this group seemed weak after joining the founding group, the organization has now expanded to all districts. Pushpa Bhusal of Arghakhanchi has become the vice president of the group, while Binod Chaudhary of Paschim Nawalparasi has also become the vice president. Yogendra Chaudhary of Dang has become the joint general secretary, while Kishore Singh Rathore of Bardiya has come out of the agreement by running for president. Devendra Raj Kandel of Nawalparasi was defeated in the joint general secretary post, while leaders including Bal Krishna Khand of Rupandehi, former chief minister of the province Dilli Chaudhary, and former minister Raju Khanal also left Deuba's side and joined the establishment.

सभापतिमै उम्मेदारी दिएर पछि समझदारीमा बाहिर आएका हुन् । नवलपरासीमो देवेन्द्रराज कँडेल सहमहामन्त्रीमा पराजित भएका थिए भने रुपन्देहीका बालकृष्ण खाण, प्रदेशका पूर्वमुख्यमन्त्री डिल्ली चौधरी, पूर्वमन्त्री राजु खनालसहितका नेताहरुले पनि देउवाको साथ छाडेर संस्थापनमा लागेका थिए ।

रुपन्देही । नेपाली कांग्रेसको शेरबहादुर देउवा पक्षले लुम्बिनी प्रदेशमा संगठनात्मक गतिविधि तीव्र बनाउँदै प्रदेश नेतृत्व चयनको तयारी अघि बढाएको छ ।

प्रदेश अधिवेशनलाई आगामी केन्द्रीय महाधिवेशनको शक्ति परीक्षणका रूपमा हेरिएकाले प्रदेश सभापतिसहित पदाधिकारी चयनमा नेताहरूले आन्तरिक छलफल र समर्थन जुटाउने प्रयास थालेका छन् ।

देउवा पक्षले प्रदेश अधिवेशन दाङको भालुवाङमा गर्ने तयारी गरेको छ । अधिवेशनमा प्रदेशका १२ जिल्लाबाट प्रतिनिधि सहभागी हुने भएकाले जिल्ला तहको शक्ति सन्तुलन, प्रतिनिधिको व्यवस्थापन र नेतृत्वका आकांक्षीबीचको समीकरणले परिणाम प्रभावित पार्ने देखिएको छ ।

प्रदेश सभापतिका लागि अहिले प्रदेशको संयोजक रहेका दाङका गेहेन्द्र गिरी, प्रदेशका पूर्वमन्त्री प्यूठानका रोज राणा, प्रदेश योजना आयोगका पूर्व सदस्य रुपन्देहीका डा. दामोदर भुसाल, रोल्पाका दुर्गा खड्कासहितका नेताहरूको नाम चर्चामा छ । बर्दियाका संजय गौतमको नाम लिइएपनि उनी त्यति धेरै क्रियाशील नभएकाले छलफलमा लगिएको छैन । नेताहरूले आफ्नो पक्षमा समर्थन जुटाउन जिल्ला नेतृत्व, क्षेत्रीय प्रतिनिधि र प्रदेशस्तरका नेताहरूसँग छलफल गरिरहेका छन् ।

आकांक्षीहरु धेरै भएपनि अहिलेका प्रदेश संयोजकलाई केन्द्रमा लगेर प्रदेश सरकारमा रहँदा प्रभावकारी काम देखाएका र शेरबहादुर देउवा तथा आरजु देउवासँग निकटस्थ रहेका रोज राणालाई नै सर्वसम्मत बनाउने गरी नेतृत्वले तयारी गरेको छ तर अहिले नै त्यो विषय टुंगो नलागेको नेताहरुको भनाइ छ ।

‘युवा पुस्ताको कुरा पनि छ, सक्रियताको पनि कुरा छ, गेहेन्द्रजीलाई केन्द्रमा लगेर यहाँ युवा साथीहरुलाई नै अघि सार्नेगरी सहमति जुट्छहोला,’ सो समूहका एक नेताले नेपाल प्रेससँग भने ।

राणाले सबैभन्दा बढी समूहलाई बलियो बनाएको भन्दै चर्चामा छन् ।

यी हुन् टुंगो लागेका १२ जिल्लाका सभापतिहरुः देउवा समूहबाट प्रदेशका १२ जिल्लामध्ये १० वटामा जिल्ला नेतृत्व टुंगो लागिसकेको छ भने रुपन्देही र पाल्पामा आजै टुंगो लगाएर भोलिदेखि प्रदेशको नेतृत्वका लागि अघिवेशनको तयारी गरिएको हो ।

रुपन्देही र पाल्पामा पनि नेतृत्वको विषय करिब टुंगो लागेको र अन्य पदहरुमा आइतबार बसेर टुंगो लगाइने नेताहरुको भनाइ छ ।

समूहको प्यूठानमा सभापति देवेन्द्र बर्मा, रोल्पामा मानबहादुर खत्री, अर्घाखाँचीमा बाबुराम पौडेल, दाङमा गोपालराज शर्मा, कपिलवस्तुमा राजेश सिंह, बर्दियामा जग्गाप्रसाद पाण्डे, बाँकेमा प्रमोद श्रेष्ठ, पश्चिमनवलपरासीमा गोपी पुन, गुल्मीमा देव मगर, रुकुमपूर्वमा दत्त बस्नेत सभापतित्वमा नयाँ नेतृत्व बनिसकेको छ भने रुपन्देहीमा गुनाखर भुर्तेल र पाल्पामा माधव नेपालको नेतृत्वमा करिब समझदारी भइसकेको छ ।

देउवासहित प्रभावशाली नेताहरुको लर्कोः प्रदेशको अधिवेशनमा समूहका प्रभावशाली नेताहरुको ठूलो समूह आउने भएको छ । नेता शेरबहादुर देउवाले उद्घाटन गर्ने यो अधिवेशनमा शशांक कोइराला, विमलेन्द्र निधि, प्रकाशमान सिंह, एनपी साउद, प्रकाशशरण महत, मोहन बस्नेतसहितका नेताहरु आउने निश्चित भएको नेता रोज राणाले जानकारी दिए । भालुवाङस्थित पौवा होटलमा गर्न लागिएको सो अधिवेशनमा सबै जिल्लाबाट आउने तयारी अन्तिम चरणमा रहेको उनले जनाए । ‘उद्घाटन शेरबहादुर दाईबाटै हुन्छ, अरु सिनियर नेताहरु धेरै आजसम्म आइपग्नुहुन्छहोला, नेतृत्वको कुरा समझदारीमै टुंगिन्छ, आकांक्षा राख्ने विषय स्वभाविक हो,’ उनले भने ।

पहिले यो समूहमा लुम्बिनीबाट रहेका धेरै नेताहरु संस्थापन समूहमा लागेपछि कमजोरजस्तै देखिएपनि अहिले सबै जिल्लामा संगठन बिस्तार गरेको हो । यही समूहमा रहेर अहिले संस्थापनबाट अर्घाखाँचीकी पुष्पा भुसाल उपसभापति बनेकी छन् भने पश्चिमनवलपरासीका विनोद चौधरी पनि उपसभापति बनेका छन् । दाङका योगेन्द्र चौधरी सहमहामन्त्री बनेका छन् भने बर्दियाका किशोरसिंह राठौर सभापतिमै उम्मेदारी दिएर पछि समझदारीमा बाहिर आएका हुन् ।

नवलपरासीमो देवेन्द्रराज कँडेल सहमहामन्त्रीमा पराजित भएका थिए भने रुपन्देहीका बालकृष्ण खाण, प्रदेशका पूर्वमुख्यमन्त्री डिल्ली चौधरी, पूर्वमन्त्री राजु खनालसहितका नेताहरुले पनि देउवाको साथ छाडेर संस्थापनमा लागेका थिए ।

Rupandehi. The Sher Bahadur Deuba faction of the Nepali Congress has intensified organizational activities in Lumbini Province and is preparing to select the provincial leadership. As the provincial convention is seen as a test of strength for the upcoming central convention, leaders have begun internal discussions and efforts to gather support for the selection of office bearers, including the provincial president. The Deuba faction is preparing to hold the provincial convention in Bhaluwang, Dang. As representatives from 12 districts of the province will participate in the convention, the balance of power at the district level, the management of representatives, and the equation between leadership aspirants are seen to affect the results. The names of leaders in the discussion for the provincial president include Gehendra Giri of Dang, who is currently the provincial coordinator, Roz Rana of Pyuthan, former provincial minister, Dr. Damodar Bhusal of Rupandehi, and Durga Khadka of Rolpa. Although the name of Sanjay Gautam of Bardiya was mentioned, he has not been included in the discussion as he is not very active. The leaders are holding discussions with the district leadership, regional representatives, and provincial-level leaders to garner support for their side. Although there are many aspirants, the leadership has made preparations to take the current provincial coordinator to the center and unanimously select Roz Rana, who has shown effective work during his time in the provincial government and is close to Sher Bahadur Deuba and Arju Deuba, but the leaders say that the issue has not been finalized yet. "There is also the issue of the younger generation, there is also the issue of activism. Perhaps a consensus will be reached to take Gehendraji to the center and promote the young friends here," a leader of the group told Nepal Press. Rana is in the news for having strengthened the group the most. These are the 12 district chairmen who have been finalized: The Deuba group has already finalized the district leadership in 10 of the 12 districts of the province, while Rupandehi and Palpa have been finalized today and preparations are underway to move forward with the provincial leadership from tomorrow. Leaders say that the leadership issue in Rupandehi and Palpa is almost finalized and other positions will be finalized on Sunday. The group has a new leadership under the chairmanship of Devendra Barma in Pyuthan, Man Bahadur Khatri in Rolpa, Baburam Poudel in Arghakhanchi, Gopal Raj Sharma in Dang, Rajesh Singh in Kapilvastu, Jagga Prasad Pandey in Bardiya, Pramod Shrestha in Banke, Gopi Pun in West Nawalparasi, Dev Magar in Gulmi, and Dutta Basnet in Rukumpur. An agreement has almost been reached on the leadership of Gunakhar Bhurtel in Rupandehi and Madhav Nepal in Palpa. The list of influential leaders, including Deuba: A large group of influential leaders of the group are expected to attend the provincial convention. Leader Roz Rana informed that leaders including Shashank Koirala, Bimalendra Nidhi, Prakash Man Singh, NP Saud, Prakash Sharan Mahat, Mohan Basnet are certain to attend the convention to be inaugurated by leader Sher Bahadur Deuba. He said that preparations for all districts to attend the convention to be held at Pauwa Hotel in Bhaluwang are in the final stages. 'The inauguration will be done by Sher Bahadur Dai, many other senior leaders will probably come by today, the matter of leadership will be resolved through understanding, it is natural to have aspirations,' he said. Although many leaders from Lumbini in this group seemed weak after joining the founding group, the organization has now expanded to all districts. Pushpa Bhusal of Arghakhanchi has become the vice president of the group, while Binod Chaudhary of Paschim Nawalparasi has also become the vice president. Yogendra Chaudhary of Dang has become the joint general secretary, while Kishore Singh Rathore of Bardiya has come out of the agreement by running for president. Devendra Raj Kandel of Nawalparasi was defeated in the joint general secretary post, while leaders including Bal Krishna Khand of Rupandehi, former chief minister of the province Dilli Chaudhary, and former minister Raju Khanal also left Deuba's side and joined the establishment.
